t2_xclass_t1.bias: Raters were shown the bge-base-en-v1.5 top-1/top-2 P2-002 candidates for each compared class (they could look up any paragraph), so the labelled counterparts favour the dense retriever.

qrels.bias: Raters were shown the bge-base-en-v1.5 top-1/top-2 P2-002 candidates for each compared class (they could look up any paragraph), so the labelled counterparts favour the dense retriever.

t2_xclass_p2002.bias: Pairs were drawn by bge-base-en-v1.5 semantic-score bands (the same model and revision as the dense system), so the relevant paragraphs favour the dense retriever.

qrels.bias: Pairs were drawn by bge-base-en-v1.5 semantic-score bands (the same model and revision as the dense system), so the relevant paragraphs favour the dense retriever.
